body:
**New game: WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers** (experimental)
- Its own look, **UE4SS** with one click (our build for the game), and **save backups**.
- Pak mods load only with **bitfix**, the Mod Enabler: the **Mods** page offers it at the top, and one click installs it.

**Choose your game**
- **See all games** at the top left of the game picker shows every game as cards over the whole window. **Mortal Shell II** (experimental) is back there.
- The picker keeps its three highlight cards.

**Also new**
- **Update check:** each mod with a mod page is compared with its own file there, so an optional file no longer shows a false update (#31, #32).
- **Uninstall of a UE4SS mod:** the question names the files the mod wrote into its own folder, such as logs, and a second question can move them into the manager's backups (#33).
- **Mod details** and **Show files** keep **Close** in view, also for a mod with many files.

**Thanks** to CooperZhuang for the update check by file and the files a mod leaves behind (#32, #33), and to HumanMus1c for the idea of the update check by file (#31).

**Install:** unzip `uemm_2.2.1.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. One zip for every game. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays. `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_2.2.1.zip` is the same file under its old name, for older versions of the app.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
